recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. No FHIR-core source fix is needed unless a future generated artifact or tool output again produces non-canonical ElementDefinition.constraint.source values.
issue_request: FHIR-20675 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core StructureDefinition issue raised against STU3 and applied for R5. It reported that ElementDefinition.constraint.source had type canonical(StructureDefinition), but generated constraints were being populated with an element FHIRPath or resource name instead of the canonical URL of the source StructureDefinition.
initial_application: No source commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-20675 was found. The broader canonical-reference work in FHIR-12902 had already changed ElementDefinition.constraint.source from uri to canonical(StructureDefinition), and later tooling/source regeneration now emits canonical URL values for inherited constraint sources.
additional_context: The current ElementDefinition datatype is active build input in source/fhir.ini and remains normative. FHIR-26682 later reported short type names such as DomainResource in generated snapshots, but was retracted after the reporter confirmed the issue was fixed in then-current R4/R5 output. Zulip discussion in late 2019 matches the seed issue and confirms that inherited constraint source should use the canonical URL, not the name.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active datatype source has the expected canonical type and a current-source scan found no checked-in StructureDefinition constraint source values that are FHIRPath/resource-name strings instead of canonical URLs.

related_jiras.note: The broader canonical-reference decision changed ElementDefinition.constraint.source to canonical(StructureDefinition).
A later generated-snapshot report of short source names was retracted after confirmation that R4/R5 output had been fixed.
